column1: # OWASP ZAP baseline — committed exceptions (T12.2.6, E8).
# Format: <ZAP plugin id><TAB><reason>. One exception per line; blank lines and lines
# starting with "#" are ignored. Read by backend/src/rag_app/devtools/zap_report.py
# (scripts/gate.sh's `zap-baseline` step): any High-risk alert whose plugin id is NOT in
# this file fails the step. Medium/Low/Informational alerts are always reported but never
# fail the step on their own.
# Every row below MUST carry a real reason — "noisy" is not a reason, "the demo frontend has
# no cookie consent UI and is not public-facing session storage, accepted until Phase X" is.
